meta.name: Song of Arizona
meta.description:
Gabby's ranch for wayward boys is in financial trouble. 
One of his boys, Chip (Tommy Cook) is hiding stolen money sent by his father the outlaw leader King Blaine (Lyle Talbot). 
After Blaine is killed, Chip decides to pay off Gabby's debt with this money, but trouble arises when the remaining gang members arrive looking for the loot
